definitionZh: :not() CSS伪类代表不匹配选手列表的元素. 由于它阻止特定项目被选中,因此被称为否定伪类.
sourceDefinition: The :not() CSS pseudo-class represents elements that do not match a list of selectors. Since it prevents specific items from being selected, it is known as the negation pseudo-class.
